replicated_originals.reference: Schwitzgebel & Rust (2014) The moral behavior of ethics professors: Relationships among self-reported behavior, expressed normative attitude, and directly observed behavior. Philosophical Psychology 27

A.reason: Reference [34]; the paper states it 'conducted a replication attempt of Schwitzgebel and Rust's seminal study' (2014) in German-speaking countries, re-running its survey on normative attitudes, self-reported behavior and attitude-behavior consistency.

B.reason: This 2014 book chapter (Rust & Schwitzgebel, Advances in Experimental Moral Psychology) is not in the reference list; the only 2014 Schwitzgebel/Rust work cited and replicated is the Philosophical Psychology article.

notes: The authors describe the study as a replication-extension (close survey replication, but conceptual overall because it collected no observational data). The other Schwitzgebel/Rust works cited (2009 peer opinion, 2010 voting, 2013 student emails, the self-reported behavior manuscript) and Schwitzgebel & Cushman are background only.
